# EDS Store

> > Wholesale supplier of medical examination gloves (nitrile and latex) and dental supplies with bulk pricing and free shipping.

EDS Store specializes in protective equipment for medical and dental professionals, offering brands like Saf-Care, Endurance, EnSure, SHIELDMAXX, FITT, and PureShield. Products meet ASTM D6319, ASTM D6978, EN 455, and FDA compliance standards for healthcare applications.

## Key Topics

- Nitrile gloves
- Latex gloves
- Medical examination gloves
- Dental supplies
- Powder-free gloves
- Saf-Care brand
- Endurance brand
- EnSure SHIELDMAXX
- FITT and FITME series
- PureShield
- High-risk protective equipment
- ASTM D6319 and D6978 standards
- FDA 21 CFR 177-2600 compliance
- Fentanyl-resistant gloves
- Bulk dental tools
